blocks.text: Russian verbs sort into sixteen patterns by the shape of the infinitive and the present-tense stem that goes with it. The numbering is Zaliznyak's, the one Wiktionary's Russian conjugation tables use.

Class numbering and the infinitive endings that define each class: the scheme set out in Wiktionary's Appendix:Russian verbs (CC BY-SA 4.0), after Zaliznyak. · Every form in the tables on this page is the OpenCorpora dictionary's own, generated by tools/courses/gen_tables.py. OpenCorpora, CC BY-SA 4.0.
